integrity: Analytic infinite proof with clearly identified published input theorem; independent finite direct-square checks and recorded deterministic program output are reproducibility evidence, not a substitute for that proof. Novelty is assessed against named source claims rather than a certified uniqueness assertion.
scientific_limitations: Binary Thue–Morse word only; the arbitrary-prefix squared-logarithmic error may not be sharp. The proof uses the published square classification of Pansiot and Brlek as presented by Brown et al.; no independent external audit has been performed.
title: Exact dyadic counts and density of the Thue–Morse curling-number transform
